notes: CE and median nats are mean nats per payload token; positive shuffle-minus-link favors the real holder.

Exact one-sided binomial sign test drops exact ties. Median intervals are exact binomial order statistics; null JSON endpoints mean unbounded. Inference assumes independent item signs; stratified kinds/directions are also reported. P values are unadjusted for multiple structures.
Primary and distinct donor draws are independent across items, with replacement from small finite pools. The same items/donors recur across structures, so comparisons across structures are paired.
Numbers have no pools.json test split and may overlap training unless a complete --seen_numbers list is supplied.

Lexical values are single-word entries from test pools, disjoint from same-kind train pools and absent from the union of fixed carrier texts in all structures; this does not claim absence from base pretraining or arbitrary training text.

Ticks exclude the common prompt tick (-1); include final flush/EOS prediction. payload_ticks stops at the last payload prediction. Pen ticks are words, duplex/dialogue ticks are tokens; use forward-token costs too.
Payload nats per tick is a CE advantage rate, not a Shannon channel-capacity estimate.
